name: draftfe
label: If return to draft, draft women?

questions.text:
Do you think we should return to a military draft at this time, or should we continue to rely on volunteers? 
A. IF DRAFT: If we should return to a military draft at this time, should young women be drafted as well as young men, or not?
questions.stem: Do you think we should return to a military draft at this time, or should we continue to rely on volunteers?
questions.item: A. IF DRAFT: If we should return to a military draft at this time, should young women be drafted as well as young men, or not?

questions.text:
Do you think we should return to a military draft at this time, or should we continue to rely on volunteers? 
B. IF VOLUNTEERS OR DON'T KNOW: If there were a national emergency, do you think we should return to a military draft or should we continue to rely on volunteers?
questions.stem: Do you think we should return to a military draft at this time, or should we continue to rely on volunteers?
questions.item: B. IF VOLUNTEERS OR DON'T KNOW: If there were a national emergency, do you think we should return to a military draft or should we continue to rely on volunteers?

C. IF DRAFT ON "B": If we should return to a military draft in a national emergency, should young women be drafted as well as young men, or not?
